         <cbc:Description languageID="ENG">The purpose of this contract is:

b.- Design, manufacturing and supply services for the prefabricated dome building that will house the telescope.
c.- Transport services of all elements to the Montsec Observatory, installation and initial configuration.

         <cbc:Description languageID="SPA">El presente contrato tiene por objeto: 
a.- Servicios de diseño, fabricación, suministro e instalación de un telescopio de 2,5 m de apertura. 
b.- Servicios de diseño, fabricación y suministro del edificio-cúpula prefabricado que deberá albergar el telescopio.
c.- Servicios de transporte de todos los elementos hasta el Observatorio del Montsec, instalación y configuración inicial.
d.- Servicios de asesoramiento para la realización del proyecto ejecutivo de ingeniería necesario para la obra civil (pilar y base para el telescopio y el edificio-cúpula).
El alcance técnico del contrato se define en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas que rige el contrato.

The objective of this procurement procedure is to conclude a Contract for the development, deployment, qualification and support to accreditation of the Multi-Component Security Monitoring System (“MC SECMON”), based on a pre-existing SECMON development baseline, as relevant.
The MC SECMON will contribute to the establishment of the EU Space Security Operations Centre (SOC) enabling the provision of harmonised and state-of-the-art security monitoring capabilities across all components of the Union Space Programme. The Contract may also include optional activities, in particular the maintenance and support to operations of the MC SECMON. - Deployment and qualification of the MC SECMON; 
- Support to accreditation activities;
- Where the relevant options are exercised, maintenance and support to operations of the MC SECMON;
